Prehistoric painted shelters, an unfinished temple, the stupas of Sanchi and the Gupta caves of Udayagiri, one at a time.

Everything is arranged privately for you: dates, pace, hotels, transport and the language you are guided in. You receive a day-by-day itinerary and an itemised quotation before you commit.

What it covers

  • Bhopal
  • Bhimbetka
  • Bhojpur
  • Sanchi

Day by day

  1. Day 1: Bhopal

    Arrival, the lake and the old city.

  2. Day 2: Bhimbetka

    The prehistoric painted shelters, with time to rest.

  3. Day 3: Bhojpur

    The Bhojeshwar temple and what its stones show about how it was built.

  4. Day 4: Sanchi

    The Buddhist monuments on the hill.

  5. Day 5: Udayagiri and Vidisha

    The caves and the old city, then departure.

Days can be added, removed or reordered. The final itinerary comes with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Describe the prehistoric painted shelters at Bhimbetka and their place in the story of the region.
  • Explain what the stones of the unfinished Bhojeshwar temple show about how it was built.
  • Read the Buddhist monuments at Sanchi and the Gupta caves of Udayagiri one at a time.

You take away

Your own notes and observations from each site.

Programmes in this journey

  • Old Bhopal: Markets, Water and City Identity
  • Bhimbetka: Painted Shelters and Prehistoric Landscapes
  • Bhojpur Bhojeshwar Temple: The Unfinished Monument
  • Sanchi: Stupas, Gateways and Buddhist Art
  • Udayagiri Caves: Gupta-Period Sacred Art
